source_title: Place a litter tray away from food and sleep
source_description: Put the tray in a quiet place, not beside the food, water, or bed.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Replace the litter on a weekly rhythm
source_description: Spot-clean the tray each day you use it, and replace the litter at least once in the week.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Change litter type gradually
source_description: If you switch litter, mix the new type in over about a week, or offer it in a second tray.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Provide one tray per cat and a spare
source_description: Count the cats and set out one tray each, plus one extra.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Clean a toileting accident without punishing the cat
source_description: Wash the spot and do not punish the cat. If accidents are regular, the next step is a vet, not a punishment.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Leave enough litter to dig and cover
source_description: Put in a layer the cat can dig and use to cover, rather than a thin scatter.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Give each cat a hide of their own
source_description: In a home with more than one cat, each cat has a place to get out of sight.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Offer a high rest a cat can get onto safely
source_description: Give a raised place large enough to lie on, that the cat can reach and leave without a fall.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Leave the carrier out as an ordinary bed
source_description: Leave the carrier in a place the cat already likes, with something that smells of home inside it.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Settle a cat indoors after a move
source_description: Keep the cat inside after a house move, then use short supervised trips outside before any free roaming.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Call a cat in with a treat cue
source_description: Shake a treat pot, say one short cue, and reward the cat when they come in.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Set out play for an indoor cat
source_description: An indoor cat needs more to do. Put out a toy and a space to climb, then play and stop.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Name the pressure in a suspicious message
source_description: Before you click, name which pressure the message uses: authority, urgency, emotion, scarcity, or a news hook.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Check a caller using a number you already trust
source_description: If a call or message claims to be your bank or another official body, contact them on a number from their site or a statement, not from the message.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Forward a suspicious email without clicking
source_description: Forward the email to report@phishing.gov.uk and do not open its links. Junk you already left in spam need not be forwarded.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Choose the right place to report a scam
source_description: A suspicious email goes to the NCSC. Money already lost, in England, Wales, or Northern Ireland, goes to Report Fraud or the bank.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Leave a QR code in an email unscanned
source_description: A QR code in an email is a link. Do not scan it. A code on a menu in front of you is a different situation.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Review one public detail a scam could copy
source_description: Look at one thing your profile shows and decide whether a stranger needs to see it.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Scribble outward from the middle of an object
source_description: Start in the middle of something you can see and scribble outward until the overall shape appears. Finish in under two minutes.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Gesture-draw an object in one minute
source_description: Keep the pencil on the paper and use longer strokes, not circles, to catch the whole shape in under a minute.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Shade by changing pencil pressure
source_description: On a second gesture drawing, press lightly on the lit side and harder where the shadow is.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Draw a contour without redrawing the line
source_description: Draw the outline in one continuous line and do not go back over it.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Hatch a shadow with lines that do not cross
source_description: Fill a shadow with separate parallel lines. Closer lines make it darker. They do not cross.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Crosshatch a form and lift one highlight
source_description: Lay a second set of lines across the first so a round form darkens, then erase one highlight.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Draw a blind contour while looking at the object
source_description: Look at the object, not the paper, and let the pencil follow the edge.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Compare an HB mark with a 6B mark
source_description: Make one patch with an HB pencil and one with a 6B, and say which is darker and which is harder.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Stipple a tone with dots
source_description: Build a dark patch from dots, and keep the dots from turning into lines.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Choose hatching or crosshatching for one shadow
source_description: Look at one shadow and say whether separate lines or crossed lines will darken it, then do only that.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Introduce yourself and someone with you
source_description: In a language you are learning, say who you are and who is with you, using phrases you can actually say.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Ask where someone lives and answer for yourself
source_description: Ask a simple where-question and answer it for yourself with a place you can name.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Follow one slow instruction in the language you are learning
source_description: Follow one concrete instruction said slowly, and ask for a repeat if you need it.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Find a familiar word on a simple notice
source_description: On a notice, menu, or poster, point to one familiar word or name and say what you think it refers to.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: End an exchange when you cannot continue it
source_description: Manage a very short exchange, and stop when you can no longer keep it going.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Describe where you live in a few simple sentences
source_description: Say a few simple sentences about where you live: the place, and one thing around it.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Find one predictable fact in a menu or a timetable
source_description: Find one price, time, or place in a simple menu or timetable, and point to it.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Take a soil sample from below the surface
source_description: Take the pinch from about 15 centimetres down, not from the loose surface, then put the hole back.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Tell a sticky soil from a gritty one
source_description: Wet two samples and say which sticks to your fingers more. Clay sticks more than sand.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Roll a moist soil sample into a ball
source_description: Wet about a spoonful until crumbs break down, then see whether it will form a ball.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Stop a hand texture test when the feel is unclear
source_description: Work through the feel only as far as you can answer, and say the test is not a lab result.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Check that a bar chart starts at zero
source_description: Look at a bar chart and say whether the value axis starts at zero. If it does not, the bar lengths are not a fair comparison.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Match bars or columns to the comparison
source_description: Use bars for categories. For time, use columns. Say so before you draw three values.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Order category bars from largest to smallest
source_description: When the categories have no other order, sort the bars from the largest value to the smallest.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Read one bar as a length from zero
source_description: Read one bar by its length from zero, and say the value the gridline or the label gives.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Warm up before someone is ready to listen
source_description: If the listening room is close, warm the fingers or the voice quietly, then play a few notes once you are in the room.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Tune to a reference as the last check
source_description: Before you play with a piano or another fixed pitch, make the last tuning check against that pitch.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Bring a person to accompany you
source_description: If the piece needs an accompanist, bring a person. A recording is not the accompanist, except where a jazz syllabus says so.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Hand over the list of pieces you will play
source_description: Write the titles you will perform, with the composer, and give that list to the listener before you start.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Use a short look before you sight-read
source_description: When you are given unseen music, use a short preparation to look and try any part. The performance starts after that.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.

source_title: Breathe, then play a few notes before the piece
source_description: Treat nerves as ordinary: take a breath, then sound a few notes before the piece starts.
provenance_note: Opened page recorded in source_url. Not a quotation.
